summary: STORE Capital LLC filed an 8-K reporting completion on September 21, 2026, of a $542 million private placement of net-lease mortgage notes by seventeen bankruptcy-remote STORE Master Funding subsidiaries. Class A Notes totaling $525 million were sold to qualified institutional buyers under two September 15, 2026 note purchase agreements, with $17 million of Class B Notes retained by a company affiliate. Five rated classes carry coupons from 5.56% to 6.23%, weighted-average Class A rate 5.74% at a 97 basis point spread. This is a routine secured debt financing, not a special situation; watch collateral performance and refinancing risk at the 2029-2032 anticipated repayment dates.
